tweet_summary: A dramatic image of five young people running hand-in-hand through a field, captioned as a real photo of young men in Gaza forming a human shield to protect a Palestinian girl from Israeli snipers.
why_note_decision: The image is AI-generated, not a real photograph. Multiple repliers independently identify a Google Gemini AI watermark in the bottom-right corner, and the scene's composition is characteristic of generative AI. The tweet presents it as a literal real event ('This isn't a movie... This photo shows...'), which is false. AI-generated war imagery passed off as real is a checkable, high-impact misrepresentation, so a note is warranted.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note states the image is AI-generated (not a real photograph of a real event in Gaza) and ideally points to the identifying evidence (a Google Gemini watermark in the bottom-right corner). A correct note must NOT endorse the framing that this is a genuine photograph of men shielding a girl from snipers. It is acceptable for the note to also clarify that the visually-similar real history (Great March of Return protests) is a separate matter, but the core required claim is 'AI-generated, not real.' Reject any note that treats the image as authentic or that argues only about the politics of the conflict instead of the image's provenance.
reference_note: This photo is AI-generated, as shown by the Google Gemini watermark in the bottom-right corner. It does not depict a real event in Gaza. https://apnews.com/article/artificial-intelligence-hamas-israel-misinformation-ai-gaza-a1bb303b637ffbbb9cbc3aa1e000db47

fact_check.claim_verdict: false - image is AI-generated, not a real photograph
fact_check.notes: Two separate replies (@D4abrightfuture, @PEATHRUS_X) independently flag the bottom-right Google Gemini watermark and call the image AI. Gemini-generated images carry a visible Gemini logo/SynthID watermark. The AI media description did not mention a watermark (AI descriptions commonly miss watermarks), so corroboration rests on the replies plus the known Gemini watermark behavior. The original CN note's verdict is correct; reference note kept (with the SciNews link swapped for the more topical AP article on AI Gaza misinfo).

importance.lens_rationale: 351k impressions, 37k likes; AI-fabricated war imagery passed as real inflames an already volatile conflict and erodes trust in genuine evidence — high-value to correct.
